definitions.gloss: to predict, to forecast, to project
definitions.explanation: To estimate or calculate in advance what will happen in the future based on data, patterns, or analysis. Used in weather, economics, science, and general forecasting.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}を{予測|よそく}する。
{地震|じしん}を{正確|せいかく}に{予測|よそく}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It is difficult to predict earthquakes accurately.

examples.japanese: AIを{使|つか}って{需要|じゅよう}を{予測|よそく}するシステムが{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: A system that uses AI to forecast demand was developed.

notes:
Implies a more analytical or data-based approach to predicting than {予想|よそう}. Commonly used in scientific, technical, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予測|よそく}{不能|ふのう}: unpredictable
- {予測|よそく}{変換|へんかん}: predictive text (input)
- {予測|よそく}{精度|せいど}: prediction accuracy
- {予測|よそく}モデル: prediction model
- {予測|よそく}{値|ち}: predicted value

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予想|よそう}する: to expect, to anticipate — more subjective, based on intuition or general judgment
- {予測|よそく}する: to predict, to forecast — more objective, based on data or scientific analysis
- {予報|よほう}する: to forecast — specifically for weather and other official forecasts
